+start_y_m : double (where the team puts the sled across the lane)

+create(rules, const Venue&, const Field&, variation, pull_to_pull,
(the operator's trials see the player's own tractor)
each puller: the reference with torque, mass, tire grip, gear and clutch drawn;
torque tuned down to the class's PTO limit (bisection), mass capped at its limit;
pitch inertia follows the mass; the same seed gives the same field everywhere;
at each event every driver guesses a gear (the best as often as they read the track),
and every pull differs a little in grip and clutch timing; before each pull the
puller's crew walks the lane (sharper with every pull pulled before) and puts the
sled where its report says the spots cost least (crew_line)
play_event with one puller the player: the rivals'
gear trials and pulls run in slices of at most
max_steps 1 ms steps (a game spreads them over its
frames) and stop when the player is due; no allocation
